paper_title: Resonant detection of axion mediated forces with Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
notes: This is a projection/proposal paper for an NMR-based search for axion-mediated monopole-dipole (and dipole-dipole) forces. The main monopole-dipole result (Fig. 2) is |gsN gpN| vs interaction range (0.01-10 cm, corresponding to fa 1e9-1e12 GeV, ma ~1e-6 to 1e-3 eV). Numerical data points cannot be reliably read from the plot; the y-axis spans roughly 1e-39 to 1e-24 and the reach curve is complex. Data points given are rough placeholders and should be treated as unreliable. The paper also presents dipole-dipole (g_pN^2/4pi and g_pN g_pe/4pi) projections in Fig. 3, which would be AxionNeutron/AxionProton type. Mass conversion: range in cm -> m_a via lambda_a = hbar c/m_a, so 1 cm ~ 2e-5 eV.
